name: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
summary: SPLICE improves reinforcement learning on long-horizon agent tasks by constructing local training targets from failed trajectories using a proposal model to select splice points and generate bounded options, outperforming GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines.
